notes.text: The supplied notice abbreviates Yochanan's title. The stored Davidson Chagigah2a scalar names Yochanan ben Dehavai without a title; its Rabbi belongs to the distinct reported authority Yehudah. Retain R' Yochanan and do not transfer that Rabbi.
